description: This file defines a React component and context for managing dynamic plugins in the Superset frontend, including fetching plugin data, loading plugin bundles, and providing plugin state via React context.

classes.name: DynamicPluginProvider
classes.description: A React functional component that provides context for managing and loading dynamic plugins.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all plugins from the API, loads their bundles, and updates the plugin state.

methods.name: getRegistryData
methods.description: Retrieves current plugin registry data including keys and metadata.

methods.name: pluginContextReducer
methods.description: Reducer function to handle plugin context state updates based on actions.
